# Planview IdeaPlace - product overview (Avantra summary)

> Demonstration content summarised by Avantra from publicly available Planview positioning. Pending curator verification against the official product page and datasheet. Contains no pricing.

## Overview

Innovation management to crowdsource, evaluate and progress ideas into the portfolio.

Also known as: IdeaPlace, Spigit. Solution areas: Innovation Management. Deployment: SaaS.

## Capabilities

- **Innovation / idea management** - a core capability of Planview IdeaPlace: Crowdsource, evaluate and progress ideas.
- **Demand management** - a supported capability of Planview IdeaPlace: Capture, evaluate and route new work requests (intake). Note: Ideas can feed portfolio intake.

## Implementation considerations

- Define idea challenge governance and the hand-off from idea to funded demand.
